correctness.rationale: Translation reduces each candidate of span<=L_k to a unique increasing (k-1)-tuple in [1,L_k], where L_k=1,3,6,11,17,25,34 respectively. An independently written iterative C++ enumerator with a direct Boolean sumset marker—not the archived recursive bitset implementation—exhausted 5,563,258 normalized sets across k=2..8, including 5,379,616 for k=8, and reproduced every advertised minimum-diameter vector. Every sumset cardinality in the admissible interval had a witness within L_k; any smaller-diameter counterexample would be in the enumerated search. d_8(32)=20 and d_8(33)=19, while all earlier profiles are nondecreasing. The endpoint L_8=34 includes a previously known length-34 Golomb ruler. Convention caution: for [0,N] the endpoint is 34, but a source defining N by [0,N-1] would write N=35.

value.rationale: A complete inverse profile on the first finite cardinality with a nonmonotone t->minimum-diameter phenomenon is a natural additive-combinatorial classification. The exact first reversal is a motivated structural counterexample to an attractive monotonicity heuristic; the finite scope is explicit and exhaustively certified.

limitations: The census is exhaustive only for k<=8, not a proof for all finite sets of arbitrary cardinality.
No assertion that all prior sumset tables or inaccessible July 2026 full source lack the data.
